あらすじ

A lascivious life filled with conspiracy through the hypnosis that surrounds Monmosu school?!

The protagonist, using hypnosis, stands up against the mysterious enemy that envisages a school life where love is prohibited!

With a successful confession, protagonist Shoubu Hikarigaoka lived the life of love he longed for with his girlfriend.

But one day, she suddenly dumped him.

  • 日本語名: リア充催眠～リアルが充実する催眠生活はじめました。～
  • 英語名: Riajuu Saimin Real ga Juujitsu Suru Saimin Seikatsu Hajimemashita.

别名

  • リア充催眠＆復讐催眠パック

あらすじ

Hibiki is a typical otaku who lacks confidence in a typical city, annoyed (and jealous) at all the lovey-dovey couples at school and in town. One day, he discovered some materials left by his grandfather on hypnosis and studied it semi-interestedly. He tried it on himself first, instructing himself to become popular, to become the riajuu that he so despised. He fell asleep and the next day, he thought that the hypnosis didn’t work, but soon girls who weren’t interested in him at all before are all over him!

item.title: Kotowari ~Kimi no Kokoro no Koboreta Kakera~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: C:drive.
  • 発売日: 2011-09-30
  • スコア: 7.290000000000001/10 (47 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 理－コトワリ－ ～キミの心の零れた欠片～
  • 英語名: Kotowari Kimi no Kokoro no Koboreta Kakera

あらすじ

When Mishiro was small, half of his soul was eaten by a toothed deity. Since then he has had to deal with spirits called kotowari that reside in the darkness of the souls of people who are related to him, no matter how distant. Kotowari are soul fragments created from a person’s suffering and they can normally only be seen, heard and touched by that individual. Even if the kotowari is destroyed, it will keep respawning unless the cause of the suffering is resolved. Shortly after transferring to a school in a history-laden sightseeing town, Mishiro encounters a kotowari and decides to search for its owner. However, there isn’t just one kotowari as many other girls harbour their own suffering.

  • 日本語名: 妹スタイル
  • 英語名: Imouto Style

あらすじ

Onii-chan lives with his 5 younger sisters. Yuzuna, Koume, Karin, Maika, and Mikan. He loves his wonderfully cute younger sisters and enjoys the life he shares with them every day. Unfortunately for their happy home life their parents call from outside the country and ask to live as a family together again.

Since Onii-chan is busy with school they decide to take all his sisters away! It’s too much for him to bear so their parents agree to let one sister remain behind with Onii-chan.
